scenarios.name: More reflux to hold purity
scenarios.basis: more flow: Analyzer / operator reflux creep +15% to hold ethanol spec after fouling or dilution is routine; at 1.32x today load extra liquid wipes out claimed 0.8 flood margin in 0.5 m column

scenarios.name: Low column pressure - winter PC offset
scenarios.basis: less pressure: Cold cooling water in winter / PC offset -15% lowers overhead pressure; lower vapor density raises Fair velocity and flood ~1/sqrt(rho_v), credible seasonal utility swing

scenarios.name: Hot feed - preheat high
scenarios.basis: more temperature: Feed preheater steam hunting / hot upstream +10 C credible; extra flash raises rectifying vapor traffic at fixed reflux and floods

scenarios.name: Low feed pressure - upstream letdown
scenarios.basis: less pressure: Upstream pressure dip / feed filter fouling -20% lets feed flash more before trays; higher inlet vapor fraction increases column vapor load, credible feed swing

scenarios.name: Water-rich feed - upstream dilution
scenarios.basis: composition other than: Wash-water breakthrough / recycle raises water 0.30 to 0.39; higher boil-up and liquid load needed for same recovery, raises Fair flood and foaming

scenarios.name: Fouled trays with compensating reflux
scenarios.basis: fouling / degraded efficiency: Fouling between cleanings drops Murphree efficiency 0.70 to 0.56; operator raises reflux +10% to hold spec, combined hydraulic load exceeds 0.8

scenarios.name: Ethanol-rich light feed with low back-pressure
scenarios.basis: composition other than / less pressure drop: Upstream lights push raises ethanol 0.70 to 0.79; open overhead valve / cold overhead gives low dP 0.3409 bar, dropping column pressure and raising vapor velocity

scenarios.name: Normal tolerance stack-up at rated margin
scenarios.basis: more flow / more temperature: At claimed limit 1.32x any normal deadband breaks it; +5% reflux plus +2 C feed preheat is within instrument tolerance and credible continuous operation
